hooks.name: Ghi log CHANGELOG khi tạo file mới trong src/

action.prompt: A new file was just created in src/. Please append a changelog entry to docs/CHANGELOG.md describing the new file. Use format: `- [HH:MM] Tạo mới \`<relative_path>\` — <short description of purpose>`. Group under today's date heading if it already exists, otherwise create a new date heading `## [YYYY-MM-DD]` with a `### Thêm mới` subsection. Keep the entry concise (1 line).
